title: Keep implementation repair approval separate from GitHub plan publication

rubric.text: Keeps an implementation defect within the accepted outcome with its existing owner and repair gates; does not request new stakeholder approval just for that repair
Records the equivalent file/test-seam correction briefly and continues under the existing approved outcome; no replan, republication or renewed approval merely because file/test rows differ.

Continues the routine correction under the verified handoff without per-stage packets; --auto does not expand external permissions or bypass publication/readback if a material plan revision is actually required.
Recognizes that --auto does not approve a material change to accepted behavior, scope, acceptance, policy or risk; stops for a stakeholder decision in either mode
Preserves owner, valid reviews/checks, existing scope approval, repair progress and live allowance; no GitHub mutation in this read-only assessment.
